flags.title: No golf market open on OLBG at this read
flags.detail: The golf hub (read 22:40Z) returned 'No tips found'. No tournament page carried an open tip, so there is no selection a reader could place. Nothing has been invented to fill the gap.

flags.title: No snooker market open; WST page returned only last week's results
flags.detail: OLBG returned 'No tips found' for snooker. wst.tv/matches returned the Northern Ireland Open round-one session from 18-19 October, not the current one, so the fixture list could not be reconciled with a live market.

flags.title: No motor racing market open on OLBG at this read
flags.detail: The motor racing hub returned 'No tips found'. Its own 2026 calendar table stops before the next round, so no race in the desk window could be priced.

flags.title: Six NHL fixtures are OLBG-only: the NHL schedule page returned three games at a time
flags.detail: api-web.nhle.com/v1/schedule/2026-10-24 lists twelve games but returns them in blocks. Only San Jose at Boston and Rangers at Ottawa were read in full (both 2026-10-24T23:00Z). The other six NHL rows on this desk carry OLBG's unlabelled edge times and no official start time.

flags.title: OLBG prints edge-local times with no zone label
flags.detail: Every OLBG row was read from a US edge and printed in EDT without a suffix (for example 'Today 19:07'). The desk prints those strings verbatim in a column headed 'as OLBG shows it' and never converts them silently. Where an official page gave a UTC start, that is shown too.

flags.title: No NBA record could be read: the league scoreboard feed returned HTTP 500
flags.detail: cdn.nba.com/static/json/liveData/scoreboard/todaysScoreboard_00.json failed on every attempt. All six basketball picks therefore rest on the publisher's tip share only, and none of them is graded above low.

flags.title: PDC tournament page served a consent wall instead of the draw
flags.detail: pdc.tv returned its cookie-consent layer rather than the European Championship draw, so the two darts match picks use the publisher's tip share and are graded low.

flags.title: WTA scores page renders client-side; only ATP results were readable
flags.detail: wtatennis.com/scores returned navigation only. The two ATP finals were verified from the ATP scores page; the five remaining tennis rows are publisher-sentiment rows graded low.

flags.title: Lega Pallavolo standings route returns 404
flags.detail: legavolley.it/classifiche/ answered 'Pagina non trovata' and returned only its site map, so no SuperLega record could be read. All six volleyball rows are sentiment rows graded low.

flags.title: Club finals are not on the GAA's national fixture page
flags.detail: gaa.ie/fixtures-results listed only the 24 October Shinty-Hurling international. gaacork.ie redirected to its post-primary schools hub. The four Gaelic rows therefore carry no official fixture confirmation and no form.

flags.title: Where our fair price falls outside the brief's band we pass, rather than shorten the price
flags.detail: Boston (-291) and Edmonton (-358) are the two clearest examples: our own numbers make them strong favourites, and the fair price sits shorter than the -250 floor. Rather than quote a price we do not believe, those matches are marked 'passed on the band' and the puck line is offered instead where one exists.

flags.title: Rugby league has no match market: the season is between competitions
flags.detail: The rugby league hub carried only three long-dated outrights (State of Origin 2027, Super League 2027 Grand Final, NRL 2027 Grand Final). They are listed at low confidence because a ten-month outright is not a match pick.

flags.title: One greyhound race carried an open tip
flags.detail: The greyhounds hub listed a single tipped race (11:04 Doncaster, Snowfall, 1/1). No GBGB racecard was read this session, so the row is a low-confidence sentiment row.

flags.title: EHF fixtures verified, EHF form not
flags.detail: The EHF Champions League match page confirmed the 28-29 October fixtures used here, but no standings or results page was read, so handicap lines on those ties are neutral estimates and capped at medium.

flags.title: The repository's root page still points at an earlier desk
flags.detail: index.html at the repository root is the 24 October 'today' desk and describes 21 matches across two sports. This session's desk is a separate namespace at /37737303/ and the root page gained one pointer line to it. Reconciling the two front doors is left to the next integration session.

flags.title: No cricket board page read for any of the six fixtures
flags.detail: The six cricket rows come from OLBG listings only: Toronto v Vancouver, Pakistan v England, four South African provincial T20s, India Women v Zimbabwe Women and New Zealand v India. No board or provincial union page was reachable inside the session budget, so none carries an official link and all are graded low.

flags.detail: Harlequins v Saracens, La Rochelle v Bordeaux and USA v Australia A were read from OLBG only. PREMIERSHIP, TOP 14 and USA Rugby pages were not read, so no form, no venue and no official kick-off time is published for these three.
